```{r}
d <- readRDS(params$dossier)
kt <- function(x) knitr::kable(x, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

Lock `r substr(d$lock_hash, 1, 12)`, dossier `r substr(d$dossier_hash, 1, 12)`,
cleanTMLE `r d$version`, built `r d$created`.

## Decision

Primary estimand: **`r if (is.na(d$decision$primary)) "none feasible" else d$decision$primary`**.
Negative-control verdict: **`r d$decision$nc_verdict`**`r if (!is.na(d$decision$nc_estimand)) paste0(", read on the ", d$decision$nc_estimand)`.

```{r, results = "asis"}
pr <- d$decision$primary
if (!is.na(pr) && isTRUE(d$decision$unresolved[[pr]]))
  cat("The primary estimand's decision (status or selected candidate) rests on cells",
      "still unresolved after their final repetitions: their 95% intervals contained",
      "a tolerance, and they were decided on their point estimates.\n")
```

```{r}
kt(data.frame(estimand = names(d$decision$status), status = unlist(d$decision$status),
              unresolved = unlist(d$decision$unresolved[names(d$decision$status)])))
```

```{r}
if (length(d$decision$candidates))
  kt(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(d$decision$candidates), function(e) {
    x <- d$decision$candidates[[e]]
    data.frame(estimand = e, candidate = x$id, learners = paste(x$learners, collapse = ", "),
               truncation = x$truncation)
  })))
```

## Prespecified plan

Lock created: `r if (is.na(d$lock_created)) "not recorded (lock made before cleanTMLE 0.4.1)" else d$lock_created`.

```{r}
kt(d$plan_table)
```

## Design

Overlap grade: **`r d$design$overlap_grade`**; share outside the band:
`r round(d$design$share_outside_band, 3)`; c-statistic of the propensity score:
`r round(d$design$c_statistic, 3)`.

```{r}
kt(d$design$overlap); kt(d$design$ess); kt(d$design$balance)
if (!is.null(d$design$edge) && nrow(d$design$edge)) kt(d$design$edge)
```

## Who each estimand describes

Covariate means in each estimand's target population, with the standardized
shift from the full cohort (difference over the full-cohort SD).

```{r}
kt(d$design$populations)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(d$design$trimmed_profile)) cat("No trim band was declared.\n")
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(d$design$trimmed_profile))
  cat("Patients outside the trim band, by arm, and the covariate means of removed",
      "and kept patients.
")
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(d$design$trimmed_profile)) kt(d$design$trimmed_profile$counts)
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(d$design$trimmed_profile)) kt(d$design$trimmed_profile$covariates)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(d$design$trimmed_profile))
  cat("Means of fewer than 5 patients are not shown. When 1 to 4 patients are removed",
      "or kept, the removed, kept and trimmed-population means are all hidden.\n")
```

## Simulation

`r d$simulation$scope`

`r d$simulation$decision_note`

```{r}
kt(d$simulation$verdict)
if (!is.null(d$simulation$extension) && nrow(d$simulation$extension))
  kt(d$simulation$extension)
kt(d$simulation$metrics[c("estimand", "candidate", "surface", "reps", "bias", "coverage",
                          "coverage_lower", "coverage_upper", "rmse", "se_mean", "emp_se", "ci_halfwidth",
                          "fail_rate", "pass", "unresolved")])
```

Expected events among the patients each estimator uses, from the declared
outcome surfaces and the observed treatment (range over the surfaces). No
outcome was read. The ATE, ATT and ATO use all patients, so their expected
events are equal; the heterogeneity setting changes only the treated arm.

```{r}
kt(d$expected_events_range)
```

## Negative controls

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(d$nc)) cat("None declared.")
if (!is.null(d$nc) && !is.na(d$decision$nc_estimand))
  cat("Each negative control is estimated for every declared estimand, and each",
      "estimand is graded on its own. The full-cohort verdict for the",
      d$decision$nc_estimand, "(the primary estimand) gates unblinding, because the",
      "controls are read on the estimand the analysis reports: a control read on an",
      "estimand the design cannot deliver measures that estimand's extrapolation,",
      "not residual confounding. The other rows are diagnostics.", "\n")
if (!is.null(d$nc) && is.na(d$decision$nc_estimand))
  cat("No estimand is feasible, so no estimand's control verdict gates unblinding.",
      "The rows below are diagnostics.", "\n")
if (!is.null(d$nc) && !is.null(d$plan$nc_criteria)) {
  cr <- d$plan$nc_criteria
  band <- paste0("[", cr$null_band[1], ", ", cr$null_band[2], "]")
  cat("\n\n", switch(cr$rule,
    interval = paste0("Rule: each control is read from its 95% interval against the null band ",
      band, ". The verdict is GO when the interval lies inside the null band, STOP when it lies ",
      "entirely outside, and FLAG when it is too imprecise to tell. FLAG does not block ",
      "unblinding."),
    ci = paste0("Rule: each control is read from its 95% interval against the null band ", band,
      ". The verdict is GO when the whole interval lies inside the null band and STOP otherwise."),
    paste0("Rule: each control is read from its point estimate against the null band ", band,
      ". The verdict is GO when the point estimate lies inside the null band and STOP when it ",
      "lies outside.")), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(d$nc)) kt(d$nc$by_rung)
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(d$nc) && !is.null(d$nc$by_domain)) kt(d$nc$by_domain)
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(d$nc)) kt(d$nc$table)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", d$notes), sep = "\n")
```
